name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which the plugin compacts at the end of a turn and then submits a resume prompt. 0 (the default) leaves the timing to Claude Code's own threshold (autoCompactWindow), which compacts mid-turn and continues without a prompt.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

smallContextChars.title: Small context (characters)
smallContextChars.description: At or below this size the shortened tool results stand, however little they cut, and no summary runs.

summarizeShare.title: Summarized share
summarizeShare.description: Share of the text the built-in summarizer gets when no topic is finished; the newest part stays as it is.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

pruneTopics.title: Remove finished topics
pruneTopics.description: Asks Jev which old turns belong to a topic the current work no longer needs, and removes them.

topicThreshold.title: Topic threshold
topicThreshold.description: Minimum probability that the current topic started after a turn for that turn to go.

lastingThreshold.title: Lasting fact threshold
lastingThreshold.description: A turn whose lasting-fact score reaches this value stays.

resumeAfterCompact.title: Resume after compaction
resumeAfterCompact.description: After an automatic compaction, submit a prompt so the model continues the task without waiting for the user.

decisionLog.title: Decision log
decisionLog.description: Write one JSON record per compaction (trigger, outcome, every decision with its call input and Jev's probabilities) under the log directory.

logDir.title: Decision log directory
logDir.description: Where the decision log is written. Leave unset for ~/.claude/fast-jev-compaction/logs.
